participating-org.narrative:
Founded in 2003, TaYA (formerly known as the Talent Youth Association) is an indigenous non-governmental organization committed to empowering Ethiopia's youth. TaYA believes that young women and men are the cornerstones of Ethiopia’s sustainable development and strives to equip them with the knowledge, skills, and opportunities they need to thrive. Through its programs, TaYA aims to foster anenvironment where youth are healthy, self-sufficient, and empowered to pursue an Ethiopia abundant with opportunities characterizedby good governance, gender justice, economic resilience, and environmental sustainability across the nation.
The TaYA strategic plan for 2023-2030, themed “Putting Young People at the Center of Development,” aims to reach 10 million young people nationwide through integrated and collaborative programming. Its primary goal is to address the needs of youth in Ethiopia, enhance their agency, and promote their rights to pursue healthy sustainable, and resilient livelihoods, empowering them to advocate for their rights and live together peacefully.
Vision: TaYA envisions empowered and resilient young people in Ethiopia.
Mission: TaYA aims to create a breakthrough in transforming the lives of young people in Ethiopia by contributing to effective systems change, empowering youth, and addressing gender inequality through collaboration with rights holders, duty bearers,gatekeepers, and other key stakeholders.
Values: Accountability, Excellence, Partnership, Creativity, Diversity
Organizational Objectives: In alignment with its vision and mission, TaYA has established the following objectives: 1) Enabling systems change by enhancing governance through meaningful and inclusive youth engagement and social accountability measures. 2) Empowering young people by enhancing access to health,education, and viable livelihood opportunities. 3) Embracing equity by addressing inequality, sexual and gender-based violence, and harmful traditionalpractices such as early marriage and FGM/C. 4) Encouraging change by promoting youth participation in climate justice initiatives, including involvement in national plans and process
